name: LDL receptor related protein 1B

function.text: LRP1B encodes low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 1B. Annotated molecular activities include low-density lipoprotein particle receptor activity and calcium ion binding. It participates in protein transport and receptor-mediated endocytosis.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Prostate Adenocarcinoma; Esophageal Adenocarcinoma; Invasive Breast Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
